entities.summary: Earvin N'Gapeth is a French professional volleyball player and represents France in international competitions. He has achieved numerous accolades, including the French league championship in 2010, the Italian league championship in 2016, and the European continental championship in 2015. N'Gapeth is a four-time gold medalist in the World League/Nations League and a two-time Olympic gold medalist.
